title: Solidroad Named OpenAI Select Partner
summary: Solidroad joins the OpenAI Partner Network as a Select Partner, bringing expertise in AI-powered customer support Simulations and training.
body_markdown:
**San Francisco, CA, July 29, 2026** :[Solidroad](https://www.solidroad.com/) , the AI training platform for customer-facing teams, announced that it has been named an OpenAI Select Partner within the OpenAI Partner Network.


## The OpenAI Partner Network


The OpenAI Partner Network is a global program for partners to build, sell, and deliver AI solutions with OpenAI. It brings together industry expertise, delivery capabilities, and customer relationships, with resources and support to help enterprises adopt AI.


Solidroad brings experience in AI-powered customer support Simulations. Teams use the platform to give agents realistic practice, assess their skills, and provide feedback before they handle customer situations independently.


## Training for customer support teams


Solidroad supports customer-facing teams across fintech, travel, e-commerce, and consumer technology, working with brands including Ryanair, ŌURA, ActiveCampaign, and Crypto.com.


Trainers define the customer situation and the standards for a successful response. Learners practice with AI customers and receive scores and coaching after each attempt. Managers use the results to decide where further practice is needed.


Learn more about the[OpenAI Partner Network](https://openai.com/business/partners/) .


## About Solidroad


Solidroad is an AI training platform built for customer-facing teams. Realistic customer Simulations, Scorecards, and personalized coaching help Learners prepare for the work. Headquartered in San Francisco, Solidroad works with brands including ŌURA, Ryanair, ActiveCampaign, and[Crypto.com](https://crypto.com/) .
